message: Last summer, we were hit with a surprise thunderstorm, and I was unprepared as usual—no candles, no snacks, and certainly no board games on hand. But I did have a stash of old flashlights from who-knows-when tucked away in the closet. After a bit of scavenging, I found one that actually worked! We ended up having a cozy little candle-lit dinner, sharing stories and laughter while the storm raged outside. Sometimes, it’s the little wins that turn a potential hassle into a sweet memory. Have you ever found a forgotten treasure just in time?
